title: Surprisingly High Redundancy in Electronic Structure Data Across Materials Explained by Low Intrinsic Dimensionality
abstract: arXiv:2507.09001v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) models for electronic structure typically rely on large datasets generated by computationally expensive Kohn-Sham density functional theory calculations, as it is not known a priori which portions of the data are essential for accurate learning. Here, we reveal significant redundancies in electronic structure datasets across diverse material systems and attribute them to the low intrinsic dimensionality of the underlying data. We show that even random pruning can substantially reduce dataset size with minimal degradation in predictive accuracy. Moreover, a state-of-the-art coverage-based pruning strategy that samples data across all learning difficulties almost always preserves chemical accuracy and maintains model generalizability while using up to two orders of magnitude less data and reducing training time by a factor of three or more. translated_title: 跨材料的电子结构数据中出人意料的高冗余性可由低内在维度解释
translated_abstract: 用于电子结构的机器学习模型通常依赖于由计算代价高昂的Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论计算生成的大型数据集，因为人们事先并不知道数据的哪些部分对于准确学习是必需的。在此，我们揭示了跨多种材料体系的电子结构数据集中的显著冗余性，并将其归因于底层数据的低内在维度。我们表明，即使是随机剪枝也能大幅缩减数据集规模，而预测精度的下降极小。此外，一种最先进的基于覆盖度的剪枝策略，通过在所有学习难度上采样数据，几乎总能保持化学精度并维持模型的可泛化性，同时使用的数据量减少多达两个数量级，训练时间缩短三倍或更多。我们进一步证明，本质的电子结构信息……
tldr: 该论文发现不同材料体系的电子结构数据集存在源于数据低内在维度的显著冗余，采用基于覆盖度的剪枝策略可在保持化学精度和模型泛化性的同时，将数据量减少多达两个数量级并将训练时间缩短三倍以上。
en_tdlr: Electronic structure datasets across diverse materials exhibit surprisingly high redundancy due to the low intrinsic dimensionality of the underlying data, and a coverage-based pruning strategy preserves chemical accuracy and generalizability while using up to two orders of magnitude less data and reducing training time by a factor of three or more.
